title: DECISION: TLS peer config requires cert_sha256 when tls=true
description: config.rs validate() rejects any [[peers.peer]] entry where tls=true but cert_sha256 is absent. Without a pinned certificate fingerprint, TLS prevents passive eavesdropping but does not authenticate the peer — any entity with a valid certificate can impersonate a trusted peer. Requiring the pin at config load time prevents misconfigured deployments that believe they have authenticated peering but actually do not.
